verdict.rationale: Azure publishes an official pricing calculator (azure-docs-15), free account/pay-as-you-go pricing page (azure-docs-16/24), and free services page (azure-docs-17/25), all publicly accessible before signup, letting a founder estimate a stack's cost. Community feedback (azure-comm-16, azure-comm-13) notes pricing can feel opaque or surprising in practice, but the core published pricing pages and calculator exist and are documented. Missing for 10: independent hands-on confirmation that calculator estimates match actual bills, and per-service pricing page citations beyond the calculator/free-tier links.
